criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Four frames strong at 432 px (4 the proud sulfur dioxide band, 7 the slate clumps in limestone, 6 three grounds in cases, 5 the four pads with 21 bare stakes in front). Held down by 8 (game-grade resident mesh, kerb renders salmon pink like garden edging), 9 (the gold outline holds a plain empty block, the monitor pit reads as a hole), 3 (type on a darker rectangular wash, satellite in a soft void) and 2 (subject only the lower third).

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: The spine holds on all nine: explainer palette, one serif, mono furniture, indigo shadows, west left and east right, and an orbit to ground camera move. The accent's one meaning does not survive at feed size: the cover slab top matches the sheet, losing pads and caliche are near-accent peach, the frame 8 kerb renders pink.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces (254 c1 c24, 2022 and eight c4, 0.791 c21, 79 of 100 computed, 0.69 c22, four c20, March 5th c11). Caveats follow c11 and c10. Deductions: c21 is medium confidence yet headline level; the fit-not-a-share gloss is the run's own; the caption's closing question goes past c25 and c14. No hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A Texan learns that more pollution went with more cancer across counties, the east is worse, and the link is not proof for a person. No county, city or region beyond east and west is named; nothing says where sulfur dioxide comes from; the close offers no next step a reader can take.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover never says cancer or pollution; the finding first appears in frame 6's body after four method frames. 2 and 3 could merge; 5 is a statistics lesson where momentum should build. The turn on 8 lands; 9 closes on a quote and a date.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register, no banned words, honest without alarm; 'A place is not a person' reads like a person. Support vector machine, R squared and Moran's I printed with partial translation; 'drawn to illustrate' on all nine; the copy names no Texas place.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh topic in the window, varied techniques. Survey stakes with flagging as a ratio unit repeat November 11th and 5th; the explainer cerulean repeats the November 14th proof tone.

ship_note: Under the round 1 rung of 8.0, no hard fail. A work order for round 2.
one_sentence_fix: Put the finding on the cover, name places where the claims allow, and pull the finding forward by merging 3 into 2.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Game-grade resident mesh, plastic shirt, clumped hair, no contact shadow; the kerb renders salmon pink and reads as garden edging.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Push the resident to a darker rim-lit silhouette at the left edge; rebuild the kerb as a wider true #E0956A glass strip that catches the key and turns its corner behind the house.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The gold outline encloses an empty plain block; the monitor pit reads as a hole.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Model a town inside the gold block lit as the brightest point; raise the sharp circle level with the terrain.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Type on a darker rectangular wash; the satellite floats in a soft void.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Satellite upper right, swath to a curved Earth limb lower left, type in the dark below the limb, delete the wash plate.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Shelter, fence, pickup and worker fill only the bottom third at feed size.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Knee height camera about 20 m out so the shelter fills half the width; type in open sky without a wash.
